sources.title: CivArchive - CivitAI Archive
sources.snippet: CivArchive is a cross-platform search engine for AI models. We don't host files ourselves — instead, we crawl various sources and index the models we find, using the file's SHA256 hash as its unique, permanent ID.

sources.title: FakeAI - 100% Free AI Image & Video Detector | Real or AI Generated?
sources.snippet: Upload any image or video to instantly detect if it's AI generated or real. Free AI content detector — no signup required. Supports JPG, PNG, MP4, MOV and more.

sources.title: dnhkng/RYS-XLarge · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is a new kind of model optimization. It is based on a new method for the analysis of the functional role of layers within the transformer stack, and on layer duplication (self-merging) to increase intelligence.
